verdict.rationale: In-product AI insights are a fair question for a CRM, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI-generated insights, suggestions or assistants. The documented reporting features (Data Studio dashboards, report filters, exports) are conventional analytics, not AI-generated insights, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
